title: News30
description: Headlines from the last 30 days for the shares the owner holds, and tonight's research candidates, from Google News RSS and Hacker News (scripts/news30.py). Private (names the holdings) and git-ignored. News flow, not sentiment; headlines are third-party text.

group.description: A share the owner holds, one of tonight's research candidates, or another dashboard name with an unusually upbeat week.

upbeat.description: Stories whose headline matches an upbeat phrase and no downbeat one. A keyword match, not tested as a predictor.

upbeat_week.description: The same, within the last 7 days.

down.description: Stories whose headline matches a downbeat phrase and no upbeat one.

down_week.description: The same, within the last 7 days.

balance.description: (upbeat - downbeat) / (upbeat + downbeat); null when neither kind exists.

capped.description: The feed was full (100 items): counts and the weekly split lean to recent days.

per_week.description: Headlines per week, oldest week first; the last entry is the most recent 7 days.
